title: Simulation Scenario (v0)
description: One operating point of a schematic: declared power-rail voltages, rail-class mappings that pin down the meaning of `follows_rail` symbols from component specs, and expected node voltages the checker will verify. Consumed by sim_harness/dc_op_check.py (Layer 3a).

name.description: Short slug used in reports. E.g., 'full_pack_20v_usb'.

additionalProperties.description: Voltage in volts relative to GND.

power_rails.description: Map of net name → voltage in volts. Each declared rail becomes an ideal SPICE voltage source in the DC deck. Includes regulated outputs the ICs are supposed to be holding (VOUT_12V, REGOUT, etc.) — the point of Layer 3a is not to solve for those but to verify the surrounding network is consistent with them.

additionalProperties.description: The schematic net name this class maps to.

rail_class_map.description: Maps `follows_rail` symbols in component specs (e.g., 'OUTPUT', 'INPUT_SUPPLY') to the actual net names in this schematic. If unset or the class isn't found here, pins that reference the class fall back to `high_z`.

expected.description: Node voltages the checker verifies after the DC solve. Keys are schematic net names (with the leading /sheet/ prefix as they appear in the KiCad-CLI netlist).

ac_sweeps.description: Layer-4a small-signal frequency sweeps. Each entry runs ngspice's .ac analysis with a 1V AC source at source_node, layered on top of the DC operating point (source_node's DC bias comes from its power_rails entry if declared, otherwise 0V). The checker parses complex node voltages at the expected frequencies and verifies magnitude (in dB) matches. Use for passive filter cutoff verification, decoupling network resonance checks, EMI filter response. NOT sufficient for regulator loop stability — that needs Layer 4b small-signal switcher models (deferred).

source_node.description: Schematic net name where the 1V AC signal is injected. May be a power rail (in which case the same voltage source provides DC bias + AC), or a signal-only node (DC bias = 0V, AC = 1V).

expected.description: List of (frequency, magnitude_db, tolerance_db) checks. Optionally include an `output_node` per-point; defaults to the sweep-level output_node.

output_node.description: Default node whose magnitude is measured for each expected point. Individual expected points may override with their own output_node.

tolerance_v.description: Absolute tolerance in volts. Actual value within [v - tolerance_v, v + tolerance_v] is a PASS.
